app.metaDescription: A local stock portfolio built with Deno and BedrockJS.
app.subtitle: portfolio on your device
language.label: Language
language.loadFailed: Could not load {language}. Please try again.
currency.label: Currency
dashboard.holdingsIntro: Open positions sorted by market value. Sell all or part of a holding directly from its row.
dashboard.holdingsEmpty: Add your first purchase to start tracking your results.
dashboard.addIntro: Enter the symbol, quantity and price in the trade currency. The exchange rate on the purchase date is fetched automatically.
dashboard.allocationIntro: Current weight based on market value.
dashboard.allocationEmpty: The allocation is shown once at least one purchase is saved.
dashboard.moversEmpty: Performance is shown once prices have loaded.
dashboard.realizedIntro: Results from sales using the average cost method.
dashboard.realizedEmpty: Results from selling all or part of a holding are collected here.
lot.invalidInput: Enter a ticker symbol and a positive number of shares.
lot.invalidPrice: Enter the purchase price per share in {currency}.
sell.title: Sell {symbol}
sell.intro: Register a full or partial sale. The result is calculated in {base} using the average cost method.
sell.noHoldings: You have no open holdings to sell yet.
sell.emptyHint: Register a purchase first; then you can sell all or part of the holding here.
sell.invalidQuantity: Enter how many shares you sold.

sell.onlyAvailable.one: You only had {count} share of {symbol} available on {date}.
sell.onlyAvailable.other: You only had {count} shares of {symbol} available on {date}.

sell.noneAvailable: You had no shares of {symbol} to sell on {date}.
sell.invalidPrice: Enter the sale price per share in {currency}.
holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.intro: Choose a holding to see its price together with your buys and sells.
holdings.empty: Add a purchase on the overview to see it here.
holdings.choose: Choose a holding from the list.
holdings.tradesIntro: The price since each trade – a rising price after a buy and a falling price after a sell means good timing.
holdings.noTrades: No trades registered for this holding.
chart.label: {symbol} price chart with buys and sells
chart.noData: No price history available for this range.

chart.outside.one: {count} trade is before the range – choose a longer one
chart.outside.other: {count} trades are before the range – choose a longer one

timing.risenSinceBuy: the price has risen since the buy
timing.fallenSinceBuy: the price has fallen since the buy
timing.goodSell: good timing – the price has fallen since
timing.risenSinceSell: the price has risen since the sale
transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.intro: Buys and sells are stored locally in IndexedDB, in the trade currency with the exchange rate on the trade date. The result is calculated in {base} against the average cost at the time (average cost method).
transactions.empty: No transactions have been saved yet. Add a purchase on the overview.
research.title: Search
research.intro: Search Yahoo Finance symbols and add them to your local watchlist.
research.placeholder: Search for a company or ticker symbol
research.watchedIntro: Watchlist and holdings with locally cached quotes.
research.watchedEmpty: Search for a symbol and watch it, or save a purchase.
watch.added: {symbol} is now watched on this device.
settings.localIntro: Buys, sales and watched symbols stay in this browser's IndexedDB.
settings.confirmClear: Remove all local Stockroom data from this browser?
settings.persistUnavailable: Persistent browser storage is not available here.
settings.persistDenied: The browser did not grant persistent storage.
settings.storageIntro: The counts below are local records, not server records.
settings.currencyIntro: Trades are booked in {base} at the exchange rate on the trade date. The display currency converts the whole portfolio at the current rate.
settings.ratesHint: Exchange rates are fetched from Yahoo Finance when needed.

stats.histories.one: price history synced from the server
stats.histories.other: price histories synced from the server

confirm.deleteSale: Delete the sale of {shares} {symbol} ({date})? The shares will count as owned again.
import.invalid: The import file is not valid JSON.
import.noBuys: The import file contains no purchases.
import.badSales: The sales in the import file have the wrong format.
import.noWatchlist: The import file contains no watchlist.
errors.fxRate: Could not fetch the exchange rate from {currencies} to {base}.
errors.timeout: The market data request took too long
errors.historyFailed: Price history for {symbol} could not be fetched ({status})
server.rateLimited: Too many requests, please try again in a moment.
server.upstreamTimeout: The market data source did not respond in time
server.upstreamUnreachable: The market data source could not be reached
server.upstreamUnavailable: Market data is not available right now
